propositions: Without explicit file_impact, any code-SHA change triggers re-review as a fail-safe, causing 21% of reviews to run on byte-identical material; scoping this fail-safe to the read-set and cited paths reduces false positives.

The read-set (normalized file paths from observed read_file fetches) must be recorded in the signed manifest, deduped and sorted, with only existing regular files under the repo root included, and any tampering must fail verification.

When dependency set is empty, undeclared, not poisoned, and not authenticated as none, the ADR-0002 machinery extends to re-hash read-set entries plus blast-radius globs (criteria, routing, reviewer, and gate files) to detect invalidation.

Blast-radius globs are resolved at attestation time into membership digests capturing file additions/deletions and per-file content hashes, ensuring partial scopes do not create false positives from unrelated changes.

Three sites (dependency_hashes, attest._rehash, compute_validity default loop) must route glob patterns through hash_dep_entry for consistent content-hash dispatch, else glob patterns hash literally to _ABSENT_HASH.
The signed manifest records currency-basis (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) for transparency; pre-change or unverifiable read-sets fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation.
